data: Amazon's diluted earnings per share were $5.53 in fiscal 2024, compared with $2.90 in fiscal 2023, an increase of about 90.7% (a $2.63 rise). Net income for fiscal 2024 was $59,248 million, or roughly $59.2 billion, up from $30,425 million in fiscal 2023. The EPS gain outpaced the roughly 94.7% net income growth only slightly in the other direction, because diluted weighted-average shares rose from 10,492 million to 10,721 million.
